problemSolution.title: Your own platform — not renting someone else’s

pairs.problem: Patreon, Steady, or a closed CMS control your domain, data, and delivery.
pairs.solution: Directwerk runs under your brand: Studio for creators, a website for listeners — and for agencies an API to plug in their own UIs.

pairs.problem: Podcast, newsletter, and memberships live in separate tools.
pairs.solution: Everything in one place: podcast, RSS, subscriptions, articles, and feed builder. Who pays sees what — the same for every format.

pairs.problem: Agencies need whitelabel, not another monolithic CMS.
pairs.solution: Every client gets their own domain, branding, and isolated data — on a platform that safely runs multiple shows side by side.

feeds.sectionLabel: Feeds for everyone & for each listener
feeds.title: Every listener gets their own feed
feeds.body: Public feeds bring new listeners; private feeds keep subscribers — the same logic for podcasts and articles. In the feed builder, listeners pick their favorite formats; paid content only appears when the subscription covers it.

types.title: Public — for everyone
types.copy: Your podcast.xml and article RSS for free content. Submittable to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Fyyd — without being locked to one platform.

types.title: Private — per subscriber
types.copy: A personal feed URL per listener: everyone only sees what their subscription covers. You can revoke access or rotate the link anytime.

feedBuilder.title: Every listener builds their own feed
feedBuilder.footnote: Up to 5 feeds per subscriber · paid content only · link revocable anytime.

products.title: Everything in one place — or only what you need
products.body: Creators work in Studio. Listeners use your website — or a custom UI wired to the same API.

items.name: directwerk-studio

items.name: directwerk-web
items.copy: Your show on the web: info, pricing, account, and private feeds — on your domain.

items.name: directwerk-admin
items.copy: Manage shows, features, and storage — for Directwerk operators only.

items.name: REST API
items.copy: Agencies and developers build their own apps against the same endpoints — or use Studio and Web.

developerTeaser.title: For developers: a stable API
developerTeaser.body: Agencies build custom UIs against /api/v1/ — with clear error codes, per-show domain resolution, and the same endpoints as Studio and Web.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: In Europe: API and databases at Hetzner (Germany), audio and media files with European object-storage providers. No US-cloud lock-in — and a DPA to match.

items.question: Can I migrate away from Patreon, Steady, or Spotify?
items.answer: Yes. Subscribers and products can be imported via API; public RSS feeds stay compatible — your listeners on Apple Podcasts & co. won’t notice the move. Talk to us about early access and migration help.

items.question: Do I need my own domain?
items.answer: Your brand comes first: own domain, own branding, own logo. Directwerk stays in the background — Studio, website, and feeds carry your name.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: We’re in early access and talk with creators, agencies, and integrators individually about models and revenue share. Just write us — you’ll get an honest answer quickly.

items.question: I’m a developer — can I build my own frontend?
items.answer: Yes. The REST API under /api/v1/ is the official path — Studio and Web are reference UIs. As an agency you build your own apps against the same endpoints, documented in OpenAPI.
